during = callback()
    # Release the fence only after the observation callback returned: the
    # adapter resumes once the marker is gone and refuses at its bound when
    # the callback never completes, so the switch cannot continue while

    REPAIR_PAUSE_MARKER.unlink(missing_ok=True)
evidence.reason: The current code calls `callback()` at line 2162 outside any try/finally. If the callback raises, execution skips the marker unlink at line 2167 and the subsequent `proc.communicate()`/timeout cleanup, leaving the paused child and marker outstanding. This is an ordinary resource-cleanup defect in `cli_paused()`'s existing behavior; the fix is to clean up the child and marker on callback failure while preserving the success path.
